description: Default: one SessionStart hook that shows the skill card, the project's decisions and next step, and a stale-install warning. hooks/optional.json adds the opt-in hooks.

hooks.command: if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/tools/front-door.py"; else python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/tools/front-door.py"; fi
